title: Analytics event repository
responsibility: Persists analytics events in a private SQLite store, reconciles historical project rows, and previews or applies timestamp-based retention.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Optional directory for analytics.sqlite; defaults to HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME or ~/.codex/harness.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.constructor.options
inputs.description: Initialization mode; deferred is used internally by open to await schema admission without blocking retry sleeps.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.open.home
inputs.description: Directory for analytics.sqlite; defaults to HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME or ~/.codex/harness.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical.root
inputs.description: Directory whose canonical project identity should be reconciled.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical.project
inputs.description: Previously recorded project identity; historical rows for it are removed when it differs from the resolved root.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.record.event
inputs.description: Analytics event to insert if its ID is not already present.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.recordImported.event
inputs.description: Imported analytics event; an existing live event with the same ID remains non-historical.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune.before
inputs.description: ISO UTC timestamp in the past; rows with an earlier parseable timestamp match retention.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune.apply
inputs.description: When true, delete matching rows; false previews the count without deletion.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.open
outputs.description: Resolves to an initialized repository after bounded asynchronous busy/locked retries; ordinary writes retain the five-second SQLite busy timeout.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.reconcileHistorical
outputs.description: Resolves after stale historical rows for the prior project are removed when root resolves to another project.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.record
outputs.description: Inserts the event once by ID; duplicates are ignored.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.recordImported
outputs.description: Upserts the imported event, preserving live status if a live event with that ID exists.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.events
outputs.description: All stored event payloads ordered by timestamp and row order.

outputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.prune
outputs.type: { before: string; matching: number; deleted: number; dryRun: boolean }
outputs.description: Cutoff, number of matching rows, number deleted, and whether the call was a dry run.

errors.name: Unsupported analytics schema version
errors.description: construction rejects a database whose user_version is newer than the supported schema

errors.name: Analytics storage failure
errors.description: filesystem, SQLite initialization/query, and close failures propagate from the repository

errors.name: Invalid retention cutoff
errors.description: prune requires a canonical ISO UTC timestamp strictly in the past
examples: Retention cutoff must be an ISO UTC timestamp in the past.

errors.name: Analytics initialization timeout
errors.description: open rejects after its five-second retry budget if SQLite remains busy or locked.
